abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Alvenor lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care.
conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Alvenor lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. This comparison was run at the Riverside Pressure Registry.

Table 7. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Systolic drop | 13.6 | 6.8 | 400 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Systolic drop | 10.3 | 5.2 | 400 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
